business_select.name: business_select
business_select.using:
app.has_permission(id, NULL, 'business:read')
        OR app.is_platform_user()
        OR EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM owner_redemptions r
          WHERE r.business_id = business.id
            AND r.email_normalized = NULLIF(current_setting('app.registration_email', true), '')
            AND r.token_hash = NULLIF(current_setting('app.owner_redemption_hash', true), '')
            AND r.consumed_at IS NULL
            AND r.revoked_at IS NULL
            AND r.expires_at > now()
        )

owner_redemptions_state_chk.name: owner_redemptions_state_chk
owner_redemptions_state_chk.value: consumed_at IS NULL OR revoked_at IS NULL

business_memberships_select.name: business_memberships_select
business_memberships_select.using:
user_id = app.current_user_id()
        OR app.has_permission(business_id, branch_id, 'member:read')
        OR app.is_platform_user()

business_memberships_insert.name: business_memberships_insert
business_memberships_insert.withCheck:
app.is_platform_user()
        OR (
          is_owner = true
          AND role_id IS NULL
          AND branch_id IS NULL
          AND user_id = app.current_user_id()
          AND business_id = app.current_business_id()
          AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM owner_redemptions r
            WHERE r.business_id = business_memberships.business_id
              AND r.email_normalized = NULLIF(current_setting('app.registration_email', true), '')
              AND r.token_hash = NULLIF(current_setting('app.owner_redemption_hash', true), '')
              AND r.consumed_at IS NULL
              AND r.revoked_at IS NULL
              AND r.expires_at > now()
          )
        )

business_memberships_role_required_chk.name: business_memberships_role_required_chk
business_memberships_role_required_chk.value: is_owner = true OR role_id IS NOT NULL OR is_active = false

invitations_one_open_per_email_uq.name: invitations_one_open_per_email_uq
invitations_one_open_per_email_uq.where: invitation_type = 'business_user' AND consumed_at IS NULL AND revoked_at IS NULL

platform_user_invitations_one_open_per_e.name: platform_user_invitations_one_open_per_email_uq
platform_user_invitations_one_open_per_e.where: invitation_type = 'platform_user' AND consumed_at IS NULL AND revoked_at IS NULL

invitations_select.name: invitations_select
invitations_select.using: app.is_platform_user() OR (business_id IS NOT NULL AND app.has_permission(business_id, branch_id, 'member:read'))

invitations_target_chk.name: invitations_target_chk
invitations_target_chk.value: (invitation_type = 'business_user' AND business_id IS NOT NULL AND role_id IS NOT NULL) OR (invitation_type = 'platform_user' AND business_id IS NULL AND role_id IS NULL AND branch_id IS NULL AND invitee_name IS NOT NULL AND btrim(invitee_name) <> '' AND invited_by_platform_user_id IS NOT NULL)

invitations_platform_role_chk.name: invitations_platform_role_chk
invitations_platform_role_chk.value: platform_role IS NULL OR (invitation_type = 'platform_user' AND platform_role IN ('admin', 'manager', 'support'))

invitations_state_chk.name: invitations_state_chk
invitations_state_chk.value: consumed_at IS NULL OR revoked_at IS NULL

roles_select.name: roles_select
roles_select.using: business_id IS NULL OR app.is_business_member(business_id) OR app.is_platform_user()

roles_system_chk.name: roles_system_chk
roles_system_chk.value: (is_system AND business_id IS NULL AND branch_id IS NULL) OR (NOT is_system AND business_id IS NOT NULL)

role_permissions_select.name: role_permissions_select
role_permissions_select.using: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM roles r WHERE r.id = role_id)

member_permission_overrides_select.name: member_permission_overrides_select
member_permission_overrides_select.using:
user_id = app.current_user_id()
        OR app.has_permission(business_id, NULL, 'member:read')
        OR app.is_platform_user()

terminals_owner_registration_activate.name: terminals_owner_registration_activate
terminals_owner_registration_activate.using:
business_id = NULLIF(current_setting('app.terminal_activation_business_id', true), '')::uuid
        AND branch_id = NULLIF(current_setting('app.terminal_activation_branch_id', true), '')::uuid
        AND terminal_code = NULLIF(current_setting('app.terminal_activation_code', true), '')
        AND status = 'inactive'
        AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM owner_redemptions r
          WHERE r.business_id = terminals.business_id
            AND r.token_hash = NULLIF(current_setting('app.owner_redemption_hash', true), '')
            AND r.consumed_at IS NULL AND r.revoked_at IS NULL AND r.expires_at > now()
        )
terminals_owner_registration_activate.withCheck:
business_id = NULLIF(current_setting('app.terminal_activation_business_id', true), '')::uuid
        AND branch_id = NULLIF(current_setting('app.terminal_activation_branch_id', true), '')::uuid
        AND terminal_code = NULLIF(current_setting('app.terminal_activation_code', true), '')
        AND status = 'active'

terminals_owner_activate.name: terminals_owner_activate
terminals_owner_activate.using:
app.has_permission(business_id, branch_id, 'terminal:activate')
        AND business_id = NULLIF(current_setting('app.terminal_activation_business_id', true), '')::uuid
        AND branch_id = NULLIF(current_setting('app.terminal_activation_branch_id', true), '')::uuid
        AND terminal_code = NULLIF(current_setting('app.terminal_activation_code', true), '')
        AND status = 'inactive'
terminals_owner_activate.withCheck:
app.has_permission(business_id, branch_id, 'terminal:activate')
        AND business_id = NULLIF(current_setting('app.terminal_activation_business_id', true), '')::uuid
        AND branch_id = NULLIF(current_setting('app.terminal_activation_branch_id', true), '')::uuid
        AND terminal_code = NULLIF(current_setting('app.terminal_activation_code', true), '')
        AND status = 'active'

users_insert.name: users_insert
users_insert.withCheck:
EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM owner_redemptions r
          WHERE r.email_normalized = users.email_normalized
            AND r.token_hash = NULLIF(current_setting('app.owner_redemption_hash', true), '')
            AND r.consumed_at IS NULL
            AND r.revoked_at IS NULL
            AND r.expires_at > now()
        )
        OR app.is_platform_user()

users_select.name: users_select
users_select.using:
id = app.current_user_id()
        OR (
          email_normalized = NULLIF(current_setting('app.registration_email', true), '')
          AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM owner_redemptions r
          WHERE r.email_normalized = users.email_normalized
            AND r.token_hash = NULLIF(current_setting('app.owner_redemption_hash', true), '')
            AND r.consumed_at IS NULL
            AND r.revoked_at IS NULL
            AND r.expires_at > now()
        )
        )
        OR EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM business_memberships m
          WHERE m.user_id = users.id
            AND m.is_active
            AND app.has_permission(m.business_id, m.branch_id, 'member:read')
        )
        OR app.is_platform_user()

sessions_select_own.name: sessions_select_own
sessions_select_own.using:
(user_id IS NOT NULL AND user_id = app.current_user_id())
        OR (platform_user_id IS NOT NULL
            AND platform_user_id = app.current_platform_user_id())

access_logs_select.name: access_logs_select
access_logs_select.using:
user_id = app.current_user_id()
        OR (business_id IS NOT NULL AND app.has_permission(business_id, NULL, 'audit:read'))
        OR app.is_platform_user()

access_logs_insert.name: access_logs_insert
access_logs_insert.withCheck: business_id IS NULL OR app.is_business_member(business_id) OR app.is_platform_user()
